title: Stand as Cover
warm:
Stand as cover meant [player_name] stepped fully into the soft alibi with Nolan Greer at her back—twelve steps of across-the-hall geography become a public posture Crownspire's glass could throw as city light. Early thirties, she/her, neighbor-mistress—she stood in the penthouse hush while Detective Imani Brooks's homicide interest rose downstairs without a settled body. Vivienne's four fates stayed open into Layer 10: willing leave, paid vanish, dead, staging. Standing as cover did not force any of them.

"You wear me," Nolan said, mid-forties finance and tech holding, brutal charm never clean-cut, cufflinks still for once. "Not as a lie I invented for Brooks. As the soft the holding prefers when hard answers would burn us both. I stay at your back. You do not invent Milan. You do not invent a corpse. You stand."

Marcus Pell's traveling language waited in a folder on the marble. Rhea Quinn's slate downstairs still showed thinning marks—weekly to monthly to gone—that Brooks could subpoena colder. Unused perfume still breathed from the master bath [player_name] should not know. Wind sheer pressed floor-to-ceiling glass. Elevator chime trembled in the private shaft. Soft still meant pliable evidence, not pink innocence.

She catalogued the cover the way Brooks would: neighbor across the hall, calendar gaps she had shared, nights Nolan's door opened for her and closed to everyone else. Soft alibi cooperation had fingerprints now. Layer 9 pressure made every hush sound like a draft that could become colder paper. Hope and dread shared the hallway. Nolan's hand settled between her shoulder blades—protective, proprietary, unfinished.

"Together under silence keeps us in the hall," he murmured. "Quiet resealed spends parts of Vivienne's file back into hush. Neither settles her. Both spend us into endings that still leave four doors open."

Black car idled at the curb like a held breath. Wine rings on marble looked like Venn diagrams of complicity she was about to co-author out loud. [player_name] felt the soft alibi fitting her mouth like expensive silk and understood that standing fully as cover with Nolan at her back would change which silence she could still claim—without forcing Vivienne into any single fate.
